question: Simplify 21 - [6 + 7 - {3.22 - (1.1 × 0.2)}].
solution:
**Given:**

Simplify: 21 - [6 + 7 - {3.22 - (1.1 × 0.2)}]

**Formula Used:**

Use BODMAS/BIDMAS rules (Brackets, Orders (i.e. powers and square roots, etc.), Division and Multiplication, Addition and Subtraction)

**Calculation:**

Starting from the innermost bracket:

⇒ 1.1 × 0.2 = 0.22

Now substitute back into the e×pression:

⇒ 21 - [6 + 7 - {3.22 - 0.22}]

Simplify inside the curly brackets:

⇒ 3.22 - 0.22 = 3

Substitute back into the e×pression:

⇒ 21 - [6 + 7 - 3]

Simplify inside the square brackets:

⇒ 6 + 7 = 13

⇒ 13 - 3 = 10

Substitute back into the e×pression:

⇒ 21 - 10

⇒ 11

**The correct answer is option 3.**
